svg.title: Nepal Legal AI — flagship project
svg.desc: A legal LLM and retrieval stack for Nepali law: Mistral 7B fine-tuned with LoRA on the National Penal Code 2017, grounded by hybrid retrieval over 5,849 provisions from 6 laws, so answers point back to the exact law and section. Pipeline: question → dense search (mpnet + FAISS) and BM25 keyword search → reciprocal rank fusion → section-number boost → cross-encoder rerank → fine-tuned Mistral 7B → cited answer. Live at nepallawai.yamrajkhadka.com.np.
